name: Shared Line
idea: The first T becomes the common structure holding the full name together.
approach: Custom structural initial plus full-name serif wordmark
construction: Purpose-drawn initial T: 21-unit overhead beam, one stem, serif base; remaining Source Serif 4 outlines at weight 550 / optical size 24. The two lines read T + abernacle / of Praise. Every visible letter belongs to the name.
risk: The long T can suggest a signboard or an overbearing roof; the oversized initial changes reading order. A wide wordmark has no automatically successful compact avatar.

name: Lifted Praise
idea: A steady dwelling-name is answered by a gently rising word of praise.
approach: Full-name expressive sans wordmark with measured baseline movement
construction: Bricolage Grotesque outlines at weight 550 / width 100 / optical size 24; the Tabernacle line remains stable. The six Praise letters rise 4.5 canvas units per letter without rotating or distorting their shapes; of remains readable.
risk: Baseline movement can feel playful or like event typography rather than an enduring church identifier; the name is expressive but not inherently a compact symbol.
